source_body:
Origin #53 receiving #34. Source conversation ready to archive after this handoff; runtime objective remains incomplete.

Delivered draft PR #55, branch work/53-b08-snapshot-service, head 24d77045575926be5499355f9d26de499ed2b5ae. Only services/mrie_snapshot/app.py, services/mrie_snapshot/test_app.py, deployment/mrie_snapshot/README.md changed. Six local HTTP/domain unittests passed using `python -m unittest discover -s services/mrie_snapshot -p 'test_*.py' -v`. Real canonical AAOI entity@1 id field inspected. No production/MCP/remote/durability claim. Configured source SHA remains operator-supplied; immutable build verification is missing.

Conflict check: open PR file inventories show #25 queue/execution loop, #33 agentic manager/audits, #43 architecture, #49 capture dispatch, #46 OpenAI CI, #47 worker CI, #15 B02 runtime, #14 B03 events, #18/#23 B19, #31 B13 and #38 B21. No B08 overlap observed. Other ChatGPT conversation activity cannot be directly inspected; GitHub claims/paths are the available evidence.

Orchestrator prompt:
Retrieve #53, #55, #34 and deployment/mrie_snapshot/README.md at PR head; refresh claims, files and SHA. Reconcile proposed T-015 through existing B00 #24/PR #25 only, without duplicate queue or manager work. Route independent service tests to existing B01 owners #44/#45 after assigning noncolliding CI paths; keep #47 real QC failures visible and repair B00 defects in its existing owner scope. Review this limited REST component; do not mark #34 complete. Prepare B08 successor takeover with new issue/unique main-based branch after review/integration disposition. Next implementation gates: production server and real MCP transport, build-derived code/input manifests, TLS/authenticated reachable ingress, redacted observability, durable append-only database/restart proof and separate ingestion scheduler. B02 #11/#15 and B03 #12/#14 own provider/TTD/revision/event semantics; B00 arbitrates contracts. Verify Render before provisioning. Require actual remote seven-ticker outcomes, exact deployment SHA, persistence/retry/dedup/alert tests and B01 exact-head CI before accepted deployment. Read full continuation prompt in PR README. No shared schemas, queue, ticker records or CI changed by B08.

strengths: frozen input bytes and deterministic hash
limitations: stdlib loopback server; no production concurrency/overload proof
source SHA is operator supplied; code SHA not independently verified
redacted metrics and remote security not demonstrated
validates entity identity, not full entity schema
